LEAK_SUSPECTED.title: Suspected Transmission Pipeline Leak
LEAK_SUSPECTED.description: Downstream flow drop and mass balance deficiency accompanied by localized pressure drop.
likely_causes: Circumferential pipe joint failure under ground settlement
Third-party trenching or civil utility strike
Corrosion blow-out in aged ductile iron trunk conduit
future_consequences: Rapid storage drawdown in downstream service reservoirs (GLRs)
Pressure deficit causing back-siphonage risk in adjacent DMAs
Sub-surface cavitation and road surface subsidence
suggested_actions: Dispatch acoustic correlator crew to inspect indicated uncertainty corridor
Check adjacent chamber air-release valves for hydraulic water hammer
Isolate branch butterfly valve if acoustic survey confirms significant breach

PUMP_TRIPPED.title: High-Lift Pump Set Automatic Trip
PUMP_TRIPPED.description: Protection relay tripped pump driver on electrical or hydraulic fault.
likely_causes: Thermal overload relay trip due to prolonged high discharge resistance
Severe 3-phase voltage unbalance from grid feeder
Dry-run protection interlock triggered by low suction sump level
future_consequences: Immediate loss of transmission throughput into distribution mains
Surge pressure oscillations in discharge header
suggested_actions: Verify suction sump level before attempting auto-reset
Inspect electrical switchgear for phase-to-phase insulation fault
Rotate standby pump set into primary operational duty

DRY_RUN.title: Pump Suction Cavitation / Dry Run Condition
DRY_RUN.description: Suction head dropped below Net Positive Suction Head Required (NPSHr).
likely_causes: Clear water reservoir level below emergency suction weir
Suction foot valve / strainer clogged with biological debris
Upstream treatment stage filter backwash cycle starvation
future_consequences: Severe mechanical seal destruction and impeller erosion
Motor stator overheating from loss of cooling flow
suggested_actions: Inhibit remote restart until tank level recovers above 35%
Verify suction isolation valve is 100% open

LOW_PRESSURE.title: Distribution Network Low Pressure Warning
LOW_PRESSURE.description: Discharge or network nodal pressure fell below contractual minimum (1.5 bar).
likely_causes: Major burst or unmetered draw on downstream distribution trunk
Pump set operating off-curve on low-efficiency zone
future_consequences: Intermittent water supply to consumer terminal points
Contaminant ingress through pipeline joints under negative pressure
suggested_actions: Check status of intermediate booster stations
Review smart meter boards for sudden high-volume anomalies

WATER_QUALITY_TURBIDITY.title: Treated Water Turbidity Limit Exceeded
WATER_QUALITY_TURBIDITY.description: Online analyser reports turbidity > 5.0 NTU (IS 10500:2012 permissible limit).
likely_causes: Rapid sand filter media breakthrough during backwash changeover
future_consequences: Distribution of non-potable water violating BIS drinking water standards
suggested_actions: Divert treated effluent to wash-water recovery sump
Verify polyaluminium chloride (PAC) dosing rate at chemical headworks

WATER_QUALITY_CHLORINE.title: Free Residual Chlorine Deficit
WATER_QUALITY_CHLORINE.description: Residual chlorine < 0.2 mg/L at reservoir outlet (IS 10500:2012 minimum limit).
likely_causes: High organic chlorine demand in raw water inlet
future_consequences: Loss of biological disinfection barrier across downstream distribution mains
suggested_actions: Switch over to standby chlorinator manifold
Increase dosage to achieve 0.5 mg/L baseline residual at reservoir outlet

DEVICE_OFFLINE.title: IoT Telemetry Communication Stale / Offline
DEVICE_OFFLINE.description: No telemetry heartbeat received within watchdog window.
likely_causes: Cellular / LoRaWAN gateway packet drop in sub-surface chamber
Solar charger / battery power failure at remote valve chamber
future_consequences: Blind spot in network mass balance and acoustic leak surveillance
suggested_actions: Ping gateway and verify cellular signal strength
Schedule field technician inspection on next maintenance round
